name: Okta Vendor App Missing GRC Vendor Record
description: Detects active Okta SaaS or vendor-facing applications that do not have a matching GRC vendor record.
query: WITH vendor_apps AS (SELECT app.id AS app_id, COALESCE(app.label, app.name, app.id) AS app_name, app.sign_on_mode, app.status FROM okta_applications app WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(app.status, 'active')) IN ('active', 'enabled') AND NOT LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(test|sandbox|dev|internal).*' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(app.sign_on_mode, '')) RLIKE '.*(saml|oidc|oauth|openid).*' OR LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(org2org|vendor|partner|supplier|contractor|external).*')) SELECT va.app_id AS id, va.app_name, va.sign_on_mode FROM vendor_apps va LEFT JOIN vendors v ON LOWER(COALESCE(v.name, '')) = LOWER(va.app_name) WHERE v.id IS NULL
remediation: Create or link the GRC vendor record, assign business and security owners, and complete vendor risk review before granting or renewing access.
